node.title: DSP8 joint-star / quotient-depth Pareto compiler
node.statement: For every integer E from 6 through 16 and L=17-E, the retained disjoint-six moment with P>=19+E and rho_L=(R-L)_+ has an exact class-sensitive sufficient bound. Swap parity and the affine diagonal-target payment strengthen the five odd-cutoff allowances E=7,9,11,13,15 by a common factor 8093/3520>2.29, with exact row-sensitive budgets retaining S_(D,E). The eleven joint candidate packets range from (P,R)>=(25,12), with a degree-two free product star and eleven quotient spokes, through the degree-seven/five (34,3) packet with two spokes, to the coordinate-minimal (35,2) corner, with degree-eight/six product stars and one quotient spoke. Each full coupling batch is odd-locally equivalent to one nonzero coupling anchor plus the complete quotient-collision star. These are alternative compilers, not proved moment or survivor bounds.
